value.rationale: The q=3, length-four case is the smallest nonbinary odd-alphabet instance in the classical length c+2 frameproof construction program, and a 12-word witness is explicitly highlighted in later bounds work. A complete classification is therefore a natural boundary problem rather than an arbitrary slice. The two sharply different orbit sizes and stabilizers expose genuine structural multiplicity among all extremizers and provide exact benchmark data for symmetry-aware constructions and searches.
